attchmntText: Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Clarification regarding the appointment of the Compliance Officer of the Company.'  In this regard, we wish to clarify that Ms. Arunima Trigunayat was appointed as the Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company with effect from May 12, 2025, pursuant to the approval of the Board under Section 203 of the Companies Act, 2013.Upon relisting of the Company's securities on the recognised stock exchanges in December 2025, Ms. Arunima Trigunayat, being the existing Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel of the Company, was entrusted with the responsibilities of the Compliance Officer in terms of Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, no separate announcement was made in respect of her appointment dated May 12, 2025, as the Company was not listed on the said date.However, pursuant to the advice of the Stock Exchange, the Company is now making the requisite announcement in this regard for your information and records.We request you to kindly take the above clarification on record.
voiceSummary: Era Infra Engineering Limited submitted a clarification to the National Stock Exchange regarding the Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report for the quarters ended 30 September 2026 and 30 June 2026. The company explained that the appointment of Ms. Arunima Trigunayat as Company Secretary and Key Managerial Personnel was approved by the Board of Directors on 12 May 2025. This appointment occurred while the company's securities were suspended from trading on the BSE and NSE, following their delisting in 2018 and subsequent suspension in December 2025 due to an NCLT moratorium. As the shares were not listed on the date of appointment, no prior disclosure was made. Upon restoration of listing status, Ms. Trigunayat assumed the role of Compliance Officer under SEBI LODR Regulations. The company is now providing this disclosure to address the exchange's query.

attchmntText: Era Infra Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Era Infra Engineering Limited submitted newspaper publications of its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on 14 November 2026. The Board of Directors approved the financial results on 12 November 2026. The company also filed the results with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. Ruchira Papers Limited and Divine Hira Jewellers Limited also filed notices regarding their Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. Annu Projects Limited filed its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: Era Infra Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Era Infra Engineering Limited submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 12 November 2026. Statutory auditors issued limited review reports. For the half-year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 4,555.46 lakhs. The company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 585.82 lakhs. Earnings per share were negative Rs. 23.91. Total assets stood at Rs. 4,35,946.38 lakhs. The company disclosed a shortfall of Rs. 494.31 lakhs in depositing EPFO claims by the September 5, 2026 deadline. The matter is pending with the EPFO Department. Total financial indebtedness is Rs. 25,799.88 lakhs with no default on listed debt securities.
